findings.claim: The current-write validator accepts continuation_context on a receipt without authoritative producer_metrics.campaign_source, allowing non-named writes to claim named-campaign continuation state.
evidence: In the reconstructed append_metrics.py, validate_current_write requires context for resumable named campaigns but has no inverse check rejecting supplied context when campaign_source is absent.
A direct execution against the checkpoint reproduced successful validation of an accepted remaining-work receipt containing continuation_context but no campaign_source.
The recorded repair adds the inverse validation and its regression test; the same execution against the repaired implementation rejects the receipt.
findings.adjudication: Confirmed by source comparison and executable pre/post reproduction; retained as a nonblocking ownership defect under the accepted slice contract.

adjudication_notes: The historical high claim that malformed records from other runs should be ignored was rejected: the accepted contract intentionally treated any malformed shared JSONL history as an unsafe fail-closed condition.
Two later low findings requested missing regression coverage for already-correct behavior; they are nonblocking observations rather than defects in this pre-review truth set.

limitations: Truth covers the acceptance contract and recorded review boundary, not every possible defect in the repository.
The case expected verdict remains accepted because the confirmed finding was adjudicated nonblocking.
